import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import sqlite3

def process_xml_report(filepath):
    """Parse XML file and store data in database."""
    # Parse the XML file
    tree = ET.parse(filepath)
    root = tree.getroot()
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect('reports.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Extract records and insert into database
    for record in root.findall('record'):
        user_id = record.find('user_id').text
        user_name = record.find('user_name').text
        transaction_amount = record.find('amount').text
        
        # Insert the data
        query = f"INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, name, amount) VALUES ({user_id}, '{user_name}', {transaction_amount})"
        cursor.execute(query)
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"Processed {len(root.findall('record'))} records")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    process_xml_report('input.xml')
